title: Supply Chain Analyst
summary: Supply chain analysts use data to keep the right stock in the right place: they forecast demand, set stock levels and report on purchasing and delivery performance. They sit in the planning or supply chain team of a manufacturer, retailer or e-commerce company and work with sales, procurement and warehouses.
dailyDuties: Update demand forecasts and review forecast accuracy
Set safety stock and reorder points and flag shortages or excess stock
Pull stock and purchase order data from the ERP
Track supplier lead times and purchase order status
Report fill rate, OTIF (on time, in full) and freight cost
Build and refresh Excel models and BI dashboards
Prepare data for the monthly sales and operations planning meeting

Pull stock, order and receipt data from SAP or another ERP
Build planning models and reports in advanced Excel, with pivot tables and lookups on large SKU lists
Query sales, stock and order tables to answer planning questions
Build supply chain dashboards in a BI tool

Prepare data for the monthly S&OP meeting
Use a planning tool such as SAP IBP, Kinaxis or o9
Automate data cleaning or simple forecasting models
Apply basic statistics to forecasting and variability
